    Bug 1942748 - Port bug 1941695: Rename USE_STATIC_LIBS. rs=bustage-fix

diff --git a/mailnews/mapi/mapiDll/moz.build b/mailnews/mapi/mapiDll/moz.build
index a013feffecf..e4318e13059 100644
--- a/mailnews/mapi/mapiDll/moz.build
+++ b/mailnews/mapi/mapiDll/moz.build
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
 # Statically link against the CRT, so that we don't go hunting around for it
 # and not find it when we're loaded into explorer.exe or similar
 SharedLibrary("mozMapi32")
-USE_STATIC_LIBS = True
+USE_STATIC_MSVCRT = True
 
 LOCAL_INCLUDES += ["../include"]
 
diff --git a/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild b/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
index 1009b8df039..9cb639f122a 100644
--- a/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
+++ b/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
@@ -26,7 +26,7 @@ if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
         "-Wno-inconsistent-dllimport",
         "-Wno-macro-redefined",  # 'WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN' macro redefined
     ]
-    USE_STATIC_LIBS = True
+    USE_STATIC_MSVCRT = True
     DEFINES["RNP_USE_STD_REGEX"] = True
 
 if CONFIG["MOZ_STDCXX_COMPAT"]:
